prs.tagLine: Flexible Terms, All Inclusive Studios, Start your Co-living Adventure in the heart of the City!
prs.location:
Dublin 7 is in one of the coolest neighborhoods to live, Time Out Magazine recently named Dublin 7 as one of the most vibrant areas to be living across the globe. With a mix of history, culture and arts this is certainly the place to live and  discover Dublin's hidden gems.

Take a stroll to Dublin's iconic O’Connell Street or hop on the Luas, a 4-minute walk away, or venture into St Stephens Green for some shopping. Check out Mc Gowans pub for a pint of the black stuff or pop into the Jameson Whiskey Distillery to learn how one of Ireland's most famous exports is made. There is Bonobo for the pizza, Token for pints & retro arcade games, Krewe for the cocktails & chicken wings – Dublin 7 has it all. 

Bus routes include the 16, 16D, 38, 38A, 41C, 41D, and 46A.
Direct connection to the Airport via Bus 16, just a short walk from Node.
prs.aboutDevelopment: Node Living has been leading the way in the studio living revolution, not only in Ireland, but also across the globe with hubs in Europe and America. Our mission is to establish a worldwide network of design-focused, community-driven, curated residences where our residents can connect and collaborate locally and globally.

description:
Node Dublin 7 invites you to be the first to experience our brand new, beautifully designed studios. Each space is flooded with natural light and designed to maximize both comfort and style. Enjoy breathtaking city skyline views and a level of indulgence that's within your reach. 

Conveniently located: Bus routes include the 16, 16D, 38, 38A, 41C, 41D, and 46A.
Direct connection to the Airport via Bus 16, just a short walk from Node. 

First Class Amenities: Our residents enjoy our co-working spaces, on site café with killer coffee, gym with state-of-the-art equipment, games room, library and for those who like to make a mess or show off their skills in the kitchen we have fully fitted communal kitchens on each of our four floors. However, should it all get too much, why not sit back and relax in one of our resident lounges, patio or roof terrace and take in some incredible views over Dublin City.

Community - The Node Way: Life happens so fast, so at Node we make the good times unforgettable. With our on-site team organising monthly events for you and other residents; from cooking demonstrations, wine tastings, movie nights, summer BBQs there is always something happening and always something to look forward to.  

Node Dublin 7 is far more than a living space, it's the perfect setting to call home. 

Enquire today and come meet the team, to become part of the community and live your best Nodie life!
features: Studios equipped with storage bed, Desk/dining table, fitted wardrobes and Kitchenette
